comparison.objective: Create safe gaps between three parcels on a continuously moving conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: Time-critical interception, temporary lifting, and repositioning on a moving surface.
comparison.success_condition: All parcels pass with two measured gaps, full credit at ≥5 cm each; off-belt, stacked, overly long lifts, or invalid scanner passage zero.
comparison.reason: Tests dynamic conveyor spacing rather than selective separation by physical aperture size.
